name: flarebox-server
description: Flarebox server: a Worker with Durable Objects and R2.

scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p test && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/deploy-test && pnpm --filter flarebox-web typecheck

ACCOUNT.description: Durable Object for the deployment's owner, devices, spaces and share links. Created for you; nothing to configure.

SPACE.description: Durable Object for each synced folder: its file tree, versions and change log. Created for you; nothing to configure.

BUCKET.description: R2 bucket that stores your file contents. Any name works; keep the name you choose here when you upgrade later.
